g.text: Randomized allocation as the system grows

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: Arrival rate = 0.8 × servers · mean job size = 1 · same policy probabilities

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: 10 seeds per size · 10,000 warm-up + 100,000 measured arrivals per run

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526579

g.text: Bars show one sample standard deviation across seeds, not confidence intervals. Lines connect means.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526579

g.text: Execution time includes accepted jobs only. The benchmark describes the large-system limit.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526579

g.text: Load per server stays constant; larger systems receive more arrivals per time unit.
